headline: Cosmetology: Hair & Nails Core 30
threshold: Use Spanish to complete the Cosmetology: Hair & Nails situations, ask for clarification, and confirm a shared plan.

lessons.title: Confirm a haircut consultation
lessons.objective: Confirm the desired length, reference image, and upkeep preference.
lessons.focus: Use question words with their written accents: qué, cómo, cuál, dónde and cuándo. Include both Spanish question marks.

words.en: How much do you want to cut?
I want to keep this length.
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Confirm the desired length, reference image, and upkeep preference. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Quiero un cambio, pero no quiero perder mucho largo. ¿Qué necesitas saber?
